covered_report_window: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Thursday, October 22, 2026 U.S. market close and before the Friday, October 23, 2026 U.S. market open.
market_context_summary: U.S. equities were risk-off intraday, with technology weaker and oil higher amid Middle East uncertainty; Friday PMI and final Michigan sentiment add macro sensitivity.

methodology.consensus: Arithmetic mean of direction and reversal-risk scores.
methodology.disparity: 0-100 normalized dispersion across pass direction and risk outputs; lower is tighter agreement.
methodology.learned_lessons_review: Existing expectation-bar, key-metric and forward-look controls applied; no new method change.
